newsitem.title: CANADA: Canbra Foods sees canola crush fall likely.
newsitem.headline: Canbra Foods sees canola crush fall likely.

text.p: Canbra Foods Ltd will likely scale back its canola crush after the Christmas holiday, the firm's president told Reuters.

"We are crushing, but we're only crushing around 80 percent capacity levels and that'll probably slow down more after we get through the holiday demand," Canbra president Larry McNamara said in a phone interview.
The Lethbridge, Alta, firm can crush 1,000 tonnes a day.
"Crush margins are still unfavourable and I think you'll see in future weeks, the crush will reflect that, where you'll have a downturn in crushing rates," McNamara added.
